HOW AUTO-SCAN WORKS (Detailed Flow)\n\n### **Phase 1: User Login & Enrollment Decision**\n\n1. **Login Flow** (`Login.jsx`):\n   - User enters email/password at `/login`\n   - Backend validates credentials and returns JWT token + `isEnrolled` flag\n   - Logic:\n     ```javascript\n     if (res.data.user.isEnrolled) {\n         navigate('/dashboard');  // Already enrolled, go to main dashboard\n     } else {\n         navigate('/enrollment'); // First time, go capture 3 angles\n     }\n     ```\n\n### **Phase 2: Biometric Enrollment (Front/Left/Right Capture)**\n\n1. **FaceEnrollment.jsx** (`/enrollment` route):\n   - Starts webcam via `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia()`\n   - User captures 3 sequential photos: Front → Left → Right\n   - Each photo is captured via Canvas as base64 JPEG\n   - State progression: `'front'` → `'left'` → `'right'` → `'ready'` (preview mode)\n\n2. **Vectorization POST** (`/user/enroll-face`):\n   - Sends 3 base64 images to **Node.js backend**\n   - Backend forwards to **Python AI service** at `http://127.0.0.1:8500/api/encode-faces`\n   - Python returns averaged 512-dim face embedding\n   - Saved to PostgreSQL `users.faceVector` column (pgvector type)\n   - User marked `isEnrolled = true`\n\n3. **Python AI Engine** (`ai-service/main.py`):\n   - **Endpoint:** `POST /api/encode-faces`\n   - **Process:**\n     ```python\n     # 1. Convert base64 to OpenCV image\n     # 2. Run InsightFace face detection\n     # 3. Extract embedding from faces[0].embedding (512 floats)\n     # 4. Average all 3 embeddings: np.mean(vectors, axis=0)\n     # 5. L2 normalize: vector / np.linalg.norm(vector)\n     # 6. Return as JSON array\n     ```\n   - **Error handling:** Returns HTTP 400 if no face detected or multiple faces detected\n\n### **Phase 3: Auto-Scan at Gate Terminal**\n\n1. **GateScanner.jsx** (`/gate-scanner` route):\n   - Loads webcam with `getUserMedia()`\n   - **Starts automatic scanning loop every 800ms** via `setInterval(() => performPerimeterScan(), 800)`\n\n2. **Scan State Machine** (6 States):\n   - `SYSTEM_ACTIVE` → Waiting for face\n   - `PRESENCE_DETECTED` → Face too small, ask user to move closer\n   - `TARGET_LOCKING` → Face in range, locking biometric vectors (1800ms timer with progress bar)\n   - `LIVENESS_CHECK` → Verifying liveness via head turn (waiting for motion)\n   - `SECURE_MATCH` → Identity verified, processing clock-in/out\n   - `UNKNOWN_QUERY` → Unknown/unauthorized face, access denied\n\n3. **Automatic Recognition POST** (Every 800ms):\n   - **Endpoint:** `POST /ai/user/recognize`\n   - **Payload:** Current video frame as base64 JPEG\n   - **Python AI Response:**\n     ```json\n     {\n       \"user\": { \"name\": \"John Doe\", \"confidence\": 0.87 },\n       \"box\": [x, y, width, height],\n       \"liveness_ratio\": 0.42\n     }\n     ```\n\n4. **Face Detection & Similarity Matching** (`ai-service/main.py`):\n   - **Function:** `recognize()` endpoint\n   - **Process:**\n     - Detect faces in frame using InsightFace\n     - Extract live face embedding\n     - Compare against all `known_faces` loaded from database at startup\n     - Calculate cosine similarity: `np.dot(live_embedding, known_embedding)`\n     - **Threshold:** Match if similarity > 0.45 (otherwise \"UNAUTHORIZED\")\n     - Extract bounding box coordinates\n\n5. **Liveness Detection (Head Turn Anti-Spoof)**:\n   - **Function:** `calculate_head_turn()` using 5 keypoints\n   - **Logic:**\n     ```python\n     liveness_ratio = distance_nose_to_left_eye / total_horizontal_distance\n     # Returns float 0.0-1.0 (0.5 = facing straight ahead)\n     ```\n   - **Trigger:** When `liveness_ratio < 0.35 OR > 0.65` (head turned sufficiently)\n   - **Message:** \"VERIFYING LIVENESS: TURN HEAD SLIGHTLY\"\n\n6. **Automatic Clock-In/Out Transaction**:\n   - **Endpoint:** `POST /api/attendance/scan` (called after liveness verified)\n   - **Payload:** `{ \"name\": \"John Doe\" }`\n   - **Backend Logic:**\n     - Find user by name\n     - Check if already clocked in today:\n       - **No clock-in yet** → Create `Attendance(type='IN')`\n       - **Already clocked in, no clock-out** → Create `Attendance(type='OUT')`\n       - **Already clocked out** → Update last OUT log timestamp\n     - Returns: `{ action: \"CLOCK_IN_SUCCESSFUL\" | \"CLOCK_OUT_SUCCESSFUL\" }`\n\n---\n\n## 4. UI COMPONENTS FOR ACCESS/ENTRY FLOW\n\n### **Enrollment Screen** (`FaceEnrollment.jsx`):\n- **Header:** \"Mandatory Biometric Setup\" with progress tracker (Front/Left/Right)\n- **Camera View:** Live video feed with face guide overlay\n- **Instructions:** Dynamic text based on current angle (\"Look directly...\", \"Turn left...\", etc.)\n- **Actions:** \n  - \"Capture [Angle]\" button during capture\n  - \"Start Over\" + \"Confirm & Unlock System\" buttons in review mode\n- **Error Banner:** Custom UI error display for camera/recognition failures\n\n### **Gate Scanner Terminal** (`GateScanner.jsx`):\n- **Full-screen CCTV-style interface** with HUD overlay\n- **Live Video Feed:** Camera input displayed in viewport\n- **Face Tracking Box:** Dynamically positioned bounding box with:\n  - Corner brackets (tactical style)\n  - Matrix scan line (when locking)\n  - Access status label (showing progress %)\n  - Person name/message label\n- **HUD Elements:**\n  - Top banner: `PORTAL_NODE // SOUTH_ENTRANCE_TURNSTILE`\n  - Status badge: Shows current state (SYSTEM ARMED, PROCESSING, UNLOCKED, THREAT REJECTED)\n  - Bottom log: Terminal state message in real-time\n- **Progress Bar:** Animated fill during TARGET_LOCKING phase (12% → 96%)\n\n### **Attendance Dashboard** (`Attendance.jsx`):\n- **Metrics Grid:** \n  - Total Personnel On-Site\n  - On-Time Arrivals\n  - Late Exceptions\n- **Transaction Log Table:** Displays all IN/OUT records with:\n  - Timestamp (localized)\n  - Employee name\n  - Role (Tenant/Staff)\n  - Transaction type (CLOCK-IN/CLOCK-OUT)\n  - Compliance window (On Time / Late Arrival)\n- **Launch Gate Terminal Button:** Navigates to `/gate-scanner`\n\n---\n\n## 5. KEY FUNCTION SIGNATURES & LOGIC SNIPPETS\n\n### **Backend Enrollment** (`server/routes/user.js`):\n```javascript\nrouter.post('/enroll-face', verifyToken, async (req, res) => {\n    const { images } = req.body;  // { front, left, right } as base64\n    const userId = req.user.id;\n    \n    // Send to Python AI\n    const pythonResponse = await axios.post('http://127.0.0.1:8500/api/encode-faces', {\n        front: images.front,\n        left: images.left,\n        right: images.right\n    });\n    \n    const faceVector = pythonResponse.data.vector;  // 512-element array\n    \n    // Save to database\n    await User.update(\n        { faceVector: faceVector, isEnrolled: true },\n        { where: { id: userId } }\n    );\n    \n    res.status(200).json({ message: \"Biometric enrollment successful\" });\n});\n```\n\n### **Auto-Scan Loop** (`client/src/pages/GateScanner.jsx`):\n```javascript\nuseEffect(() => {\n    startGateCamera();\n    const scanInterval = setInterval(() => performPerimeterScan(), 800);  // Auto-scan every 800ms\n    \n    return () => {\n        stopGateCamera();\n        clearInterval(scanInterval);\n    };\n}, []);\n```\n\n### **Recognition Logic** (`ai-service/main.py`):\n```python\n@app.post(\"/user/recognize\")\nasync def recognize(request: RecognitionRequest):\n    # Decode image from base64\n    # Run InsightFace detection\n    \n    live_faces = face_app.get(img)\n    \n    for face in live_faces:\n        live_embedding = face.embedding / np.linalg.norm(face.embedding)\n        \n        # Compare against all known faces\n        for known in known_faces:\n            sim = np.dot(live_embedding, known[\"embedding\"])\n            if sim > 0.45:  # THRESHOLD\n                best_name = known[\"name\"]\n        \n        # Calculate liveness ratio (head turn)\n        liveness_ratio = calculate_head_turn(face.kps)\n        \n        return {\n            \"user\": {\"name\": best_name, \"confidence\": sim},\n            \"box\": [x, y, width, height],\n            \"liveness_ratio\": liveness_ratio\n        }\n```\n\n### **Automatic Clock-In/Out** (`server/routes/attendance.js`):\n```javascript\nrouter.post('/scan', async (req, res) => {\n    const { name } = req.body;\n    \n    const user = await User.findOne({ where: { name } });\n    \n    const existingLogsToday = await Attendance.findAll({\n        where: {\n            userId: user.id,\n            timestamp: { [Op.between]: [startOfToday, endOfToday] }\n        }\n    });\n    \n    const hasClockedIn = existingLogsToday.some(log => log.type === 'IN');\n    const hasClockedOut = existingLogsToday.some(log => log.type === 'OUT');\n    \n    if (!hasClockedIn) {\n        await Attendance.create({ userId, type: 'IN', timestamp: new Date() });\n        actionTaken = \"CLOCK_IN_SUCCESSFUL\";\n    } else if (hasClockedIn && !hasClockedOut) {\n        await Attendance.create({ userId, type: 'OUT', timestamp: new Date() });\n        actionTaken = \"CLOCK_OUT_SUCCESSFUL\";\n    }\n    \n    return res.status(200).json({ status: \"SUCCESS\", action: actionTaken });\n});\n```\n\n---\n\n## 6.
